jobs.description:
Mycronic is a global high-tech company whose innovative solutions have been advancing electronics technology for over 50 years. Today we continue to grow and serve customers in an expanding variety of industries. What we do impacts the future of technology, and in turn, the way we live our lives tomorrow. We’re looking for people to join our talented, motivated and friendly team on the cutting-edge. Here, in an open, collaborative and flexible environment, you’ll work alongside leading industry experts and take on challenging projects that bring tomorrow’s electronics to life. Welcome to Mycronic!
About the role
Mycronic has experienced strong growth in recent years, both organically and through acquisitions. With headquarters in Sweden, Mycronic is a global organization with subsidiaries, agents, and distributors in over 50 countries. In this role, you will be part of Mycronic's PCB Assembly Solutions division (PA), a leading provider of equipment and solutions for surface mount technology (SMT). Our solutions enable electronics manufacturers to adapt production quickly while maintaining high efficiency, ranging from individual systems for specific process steps to complete production lines and advanced software for assembly process management and connected factories. 
In this role, you will be part of a multidisciplinary engineering group comprising mechanical, electronics, and mechatronics engineers. You will also collaborate closely with colleagues across different functions, including architects, service, project management, product management, production, and management. With the majority of Mycronic’s R&D operations and production facilities located on-site in Kista, you will have the opportunity to work in close proximity to both the products you develop and the people involved in bringing them to life.
Work tasks
You will take part in the entire development chain, from requirements specification to design and implementation, while working with a diverse range of materials and technologies, including welded and machined steel structures, large and small aluminum and plastic components, high-precision parts, and units for highly accurate motion control. You will work with a range of products within the PA Division, including for example Mycronic Jet Printers, MYTower systems and Pick-and-Place machines.
You will, for example:

Work with the design of mechanical components and functions.

Participate in multiple parallel projects, covering new product development, maintenance, improvements to existing solutions, and product redesign.

Participate in defining requirements and requirements reviews.

Perform verification and documentation to ensure that designs meet specified requirements.

Contribute to the development and improvement of existing ways of working and solutions by identifying opportunities for improvement and suggesting new solutions, features and accessories.

We are looking for
This role is ideal for a curious and collaborative Mechanical Design Engineer with a genuine passion for technology and engineering. You enjoy exploring new ideas, challenging existing solutions and finding better ways of working. You are eager to develop your skills, share your knowledge and learn from the experience and perspectives of others. You enjoy working hands-on with mechanical design, turning ideas into practical solutions and contributing to continuous improvements. You are a team player who values open communication, enjoys collaborating across functions and is motivated by solving technical challenges together.
Furthermore, you have:
A bachelor’s or master’s degree in mechanics, mechatronics, or a related field. 
At least some years of professional experience in mechanical engineering, covering the entire development life cycle. 
Good knowledge in CAD, Mycronic uses SolidWorks. 
Strong proficiency in English and good knowledge of Swedish (or a willingness to learn).

Other information
Start: By agreement. 
Location: Stockholm, Kista. 
Employment: Permanent, Full-time. 
Contact information: Senior Recruitment Consultant Johanna Sörell, johanna.sorell@academicwork.se. Recruitment Coordinator Vera Mohlin, vera.mohlin@academicwork.se.
This recruitment process is managed by Academic Work. Mycronic requests that all questions regarding the position are directed to Academic Work.
Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase.

Problem-solving and personality test

Phone interview with Academic Work

In-depth interview with Academic Work

Interviews with Mycronic

Reference check + decision

🚀 We are looking for: Testing Engineer – Vehicle Testing, Active Safety & Automated Vehicles
Company: Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB
Role: Testing engineer
Specialization: Vehicle Inspection | Active Security | Automated Vehicles | Test & Verification
Number of posts: 1
Location: Hällered, outside Sandhult, Sweden
Start date: November 30, 2026
End date: November 29, 2027
Assignment period: 12 months
Application deadline: November 24, 2026, 00:00 CET
About the role
Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB is seeking a dedicated Testing Engineer who wants to contribute to the development and verification of technology within active safety, automation, and the transport systems of the future.
You will work in a technical team focused on feature development and verification of active safety systems and automated vehicles. The role includes planning and conducting vehicle testing as well as analyzing and documenting test results.
You will work hands-on with both passenger cars and trucks on advanced test tracks and use specialized testing equipment, including driving robot systems and measuring instruments.
The role involves close collaboration with technical specialists, functional managers, developers, and customers. You are expected to contribute technical understanding, accuracy, and a professional approach throughout the entire testing process.
Main tasks
Plan, prepare, lead, and carry out various types of testing assignments.
Conduct vehicle testing with passenger cars and trucks on special test tracks.
Work with advanced testing equipment, including installed robotic systems and measurement equipment.
Collect, analyze, and document test results.
Report test results and ensure clear technical documentation.
Support functional managers and development teams in the ongoing work of developing and verifying products.
Contribute to the development and improvement of testing methods, test equipment, and work processes.
Maintain ongoing contact with customers and ensure a professional and service-oriented collaboration.
Represent the organization with high technical expertise and a solution-oriented approach.

Qualifications and mandatory competence
We are looking for someone with relevant technical education and experience in vehicle-related testing.
Education
Bachelor's or master's degree in mechatronics, electrical engineering, or a related technical field.
Alternatively, equivalent relevant post-secondary education.

Technical experience
Experience in vehicle-related testing and verification.
Experience with advanced measuring equipment.
Experience with ABD missile systems.
Ability to conduct technical tests, analyze results, and document conclusions.

Language and driver's license
Excellent knowledge of Swedish and English, both spoken and written.
Swedish category B driving license.
Good driving experience.

Meritorious competence
It is an advantage if you also have:
C, CE, and/or D driving licenses.
Experience in customer-focused technical assignments.
Programming skills in Python and/or MATLAB.
Additional experience with advanced test systems, vehicle measurements, and automated test environments.

Personal qualities
We value that you are:
Analytical and meticulous with a structured approach.
Practical and comfortable working outdoors in test environments.
Independent and responsible in planning and conducting tests.
Communicative and service-oriented in contact with customers and colleagues.
Solution-oriented and interested in new technology in vehicles, safety, and automation.
A team player who enjoys collaborating in cross-functional technical teams.

Location and assignment period
Location: Hällered, outside Sandhult, Sweden
Start date: November 30, 2026
End date: November 29, 2027
The role is mainly related to practical work in vehicle and test environments. Presence on test tracks is required to carry out the testing activities.

Attach an updated CV clearly describing your education, experience in vehicle testing, ABD robotic systems, measuring equipment, and relevant programming skills. Also specify your availability and driver's license eligibility.

As we scale, we're seeking a results-driven Strategic Business Developer to fuel growth, deepen client relationships, and help us deliver transformational experiences.
In this role, you will be at the forefront of how organizations across different industries understand, explore, and work with AI. If you're excited by the idea of empowering others through education, we’d love to hear from you.
Your Role
As a Strategic Business Developer you will partner with clients to understand goals, explore options, and co-create clear program proposals. Work alongside our design, marketing, and operations teams to ensure a consistent and seamless experience from first meeting through delivery. You’ll also participate in AI programs to gather insights, strengthen relationships, and identify thoughtful next steps.
Identify new business opportunities by understanding client needs and challenges, and articulating the transformative impact AI can have on their business.
Develop and advance pipeline through targeted outreach and timely follow-up; align with marketing on campaigns and events.
Run discovery and solutioning: diagnose goals, shape recommendations, and translate needs into clear program proposals.
Own core deal stages: qualify, scope, propose, negotiate, and close mid- to large-size engagements.
Lead key relationships: serve as the day-to-day point for strategic accounts; steward executive touchpoints and stakeholder alignment.
Support “all things program + sales”: contribute to decks, one-pagers, agendas, briefs, delivery checklists, follow-ups, and case studies.
Partner cross-functionally: channel client and market insights to refine offerings, messaging, and GTM; ensure strong handoffs to delivery.
Represent the brand at webinars, workshops, and industry events- and convert interest into next steps.

What You Bring
Experienced in sales or business development (edtech, training, consulting, or services a plus) ideally from a fast-moving environment, selling technology, data or digital transformation solutions.
Exceptional relationship-building skills and natural ability to connect with people at every level, turning first conversations to long-term partnerships.
Confident with outbound outreach and meeting activity/pipeline targets.
Creative and solution-oriented mindset; you think beyond templates to design what fits the client best.
Strong presentation and storytelling skills with senior stakeholders; clear, persuasive writing.
Experienced in supporting program delivery (workshops, cohorts, trainings) and collaborating across teams.
Organized, process-driven, and comfortable with CRM, funnel metrics, and forecasting.
Genuine curiosity about AI, leadership, and learning; you like turning ideas into action.
Fluent in English and Swedish.

How You Operate
You thrive in high-velocity environments and keep standards high while moving quickly. You’re proactive, resourceful, and hungry to do your best- willing to roll up your sleeves and do what it takes to turn opportunities into impact. You stay grounded, put the mission and team ahead of ego, and measure success by shared results.
What we offer: 
Hands-On Impact: A unique opportunity to drive sales for high-impact programs that empower leaders and organizations worldwide.
Dynamic Environment: Be part of a vibrant, innovative team that values creativity, collaboration, and results.
High Candor, Low Ceremony: We give direct, respectful feedback - fast.
Career Advancement: Accelerate your career in a rapidly expanding company with opportunities for leadership and professional growth as a member of our leadership team.
Global Opportunities: Build relationships with top professionals and organizations across the globe.

Ready to make an impact?
If you want to help organizations take their next step with AI, and you thrive where relationships, strategy and results meet, we'd love to hear from you. Apply with your CV and few lines about why this role speaks to you. We review applications continuously, so don't wait to apply.
